Declared pairs are therefore: form C2-O25 (2,25); break C2=N4 (2,4); form O10-H27 (10,27); break O25-H27 (25,27) — chemically the same elementary step as the registry text (water adds across C2=N20, its second proton goes to the carboxylate), just with the H labels corrected.
